issues.title: Doctrine ORM tries to recreate partial indexes with the same definition every time.
Add microseconds support on datetime/time types
MySQL + deadlock leads to `SAVEPOINT DOCTRINE_x does not exist`
Migrations not ever in sync with the DB
Expose the underlying statement in DBAL statements

### Release Notes for [4.5.1](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/milestone/196)



### 4.5.1

- Total issues resolved: **0**
- Total pull requests resolved: **7**
- Total contributors: **6**

#### Schema Comparison,Test Suite

 - [7598: Rename the comparison helpers of functional tests](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7598) thanks to @morozov

#### Static Analysis

 - [7562: Bump PHPStan to 2.3.4](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7562) thanks to @derrabus

#### Bug,Error Handling,MariaDB

 - [7553: Handle MariaDB error 1020 as a deadlock](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7553) thanks to @MohannadElemary

#### Error Handling,Transactions,oci8

 - [7550: Re-enable auto-commit in OCI8 when commit fails](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7550) thanks to @lazerg

#### Documentation

 - [7548: Describe the types listed by Symfony's debug:autoconfiguration command](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7548) thanks to @nicolas-grekas

#### Bug,MariaDB,MySQL,Schema Introspection,Unique Constraints

 - [7540: Do not introspect unique constraints on MySQL](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7540) thanks to @morozov

#### Bug,Error Handling,PostgreSQL

 - [7530: Handle PostgreSQL 18 RESTRICT violations](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/pull/7530) thanks to @natsuki-engr

#### Changes from lower branches

 - This release contains all changes from the [3.10.7](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/releases/tag/3.10.7) release.
